THE 1[KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA] BUS STAND AND 
TRAFFIC CONTROL (PESHAWAR) ORDINANCE, 1975.

2[KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA] ORDINANCE NO. IV OF 1975. 
 
                                                                              [24thJanuary, 1975]

AN 
ORDINANCE 
to provide for measures to remove and prevent traffic congestion and to
regulate movement of vehicular traffic within the limits of Municipal
Committee, Peshawar.
Preamble.

WHEREAS it is expedient to provide for measures to remove and 
prevent traffic congestion and to regulate movement of vehicular traffic 
within the limits of Municipal Committee, Peshawar.

AND WHEREAS the Provincial Assembly is not in session and 
the Governor of the 3[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa] Province is satisfied that 
circumstances exist which render it necessary to take immediate action. 
 
         NOW, THEREFORE, in exercise of the powers conferred by 
clause (1) of Article 128 of the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of 
Pakistan, the Governor of the 4[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa] Province is 
pleased to make and promulgate the following Ordinance:—

Short title and 
commencement.

1.       (1) This Ordinance may be called the 5[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa] Bus 
stand and Traffic Control (Peshawar) Ordinance, 1975.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

2.        In this Ordinance unless the context otherwise requires,— 
  Definitions.

(a)     "bus stand" means the stand provided by the Municipal 
Committee, Peshawar, for halting stage carriages;

(b)     "Commissioner" means the Commissioner, Peshawar 
Division and includes an officer who may be appointed by 
Government to exercise the powers of Commissioner under this 
Ordinance;

(c)     "Government" means the Government of the 1[Khyber 
Pakhtunkhwa];

(d)    "rules" mean the rules made under this Ordinance; and 
 
(e)     "stage carriage" means the stage carriage as defined in the 
West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 (W. P. Ord No. 
XIX of 1965).

Prohibition of 
keeping bus 
stand.

3.     No person, company or association plying stage carriage to, 
from or through the limits of the Municipal Committee. Peshawar, 
shall keep within such limits any Stand (Adda) or use any place, 
including a highway, road or street within the said limits, for 
picking up or setting down the passengers or halting the stage 
carriage, except at the place allotted for the purpose in the bus 
stand.

Provision and 
maintenance of 
bus stand.

4.     The Commissioner may require the Municipal Committee, 
Peshawar, to provide and maintain within its limits bus stands at 
such places as may be approved by him.

Shifting of    
stands.

5.      All existing Stands (Adda) within the limits of Municipal 
Committee, Peshawar, shall cease to function and be shifted to the 
bus stand within one month of the promulgation of this Ordinance, 
or within such further period as may be fixed by the Commissioner.

Power of 
Commissioner.

6.      Notwithstanding anything to the contrary contained in any 
other law for the time being in force, or any decree, judgment or 
order of any Court or Authority, the Commissioner, for the 
purposes of this Ordinance, may

(a)     acquire any land required for the bus stand, 
approaches and roads and eject forcibly any person in possession 
thereof, on payment of such compensation as may be determined 
by the Collector Acquisition in accordance with the principles laid 
down in the Land Acquisition Act, 1894; and

(b)    direct the Municipal Committee, Peshawar, to 
regulate the administration of bus stand established under this 
Ordinance, in accordance with the rules framed for the purpose.

Officer authorized to 
impound stage 
carriage.

7.      Any stage carriage found plying or at halt in contravention 
of any of the provisions of this Ordinance or the directions issued 
by the commissioner in pursuance of this Ordinance shall be 
impounded by an officer authorized by the Commissioner in this 
behalf, or by any Police Officer not below the rank of an Assistant 
Sub- Inspector.
Payment of rent.

8.     Any person, company or association using the bus stand, or 
using any land belonging to the Municipal Committee, Peshawar, 
for running a bus stand shall pay such rent to the Municipal 
Committee or to any person on its behalf as may be fixed by the 
rules . Any arrear of rent due from any such person, company or 
association, shall be recoverable as arrears of land revenue.

Delegation of 
powers.

9.     The Commissioner may delegate any of the powers vested in 
him under this Ordinance to any officer subordinate to him, or to 
the Municipal Committee, Peshawar, or any officer thereof.
Exemption.

10.    The Commissioner may exempt any stage carriage or class 
of stage carriages from the operation of all or any of the 
provisions of this Ordinance.
Penalty.

11.    Any person who contravenes or attempts to contravene or 
abets the contravention of any provisions of this Ordinance or any 
directions issued by the Commissioner in pursuance of this 
Ordinance or the rules framed there under, shall be punished with 
imprisonment for a term which may extend to six months or with 
fine which may extend to five thousand rupees or with both on a 
complaint by the Chairman, Chief Officer or Taxation Officer of 
the Municipal Committee, Peshawar, or by a Police Officer not

below the rank of an Assistant Sub-Inspector.
Rules.

12.    Government may make rules to carry out the purposes of 
this Ordinance.
